summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of 4 bug fixes + 3 regression checks for Sentinel Family invite/onboarding flow and group detail UI. All items PASSED. Testing done on mobile viewport (390x844) against live preview URL using real invite-link flow (new invite-link generated via POST /groups/{id}/invite-link on ana.demo's 'Grupo 1') and brand-new test registrations.

issues: Minor copy bug (pre-existing, unrelated to requested fixes): for multi-use link invitations, 'Estado de envío:' shows the raw backend status string 'open' untranslated, instead of a Spanish label like the other statuses (prepared/dispatched are translated, 'open' is not in the switch in sheets.tsx line ~103).

action_items: Optional minor fix: add 'open' case to the inv.status translation switch in src/components/sheets.tsx (MemberSheet) so multi-use link invitations show a translated Spanish label instead of raw 'open'.
critical_code_review_comments: account.tsx and profile.tsx correctly gate on server-persisted onboarding.step ('profile'->consent->profile->group/invite), verified against actual backend router logic (auth.py sets step='profile' on register; people.py sets step='group' after profile save, step='done' after group/invite acceptance) - fix is server-state-driven, not just client-side, so it is robust across sessions/devices.
invite/[token].tsx correctly stores 'sentinel.pending_invite' via storage before pushing into onboarding and clears it on both accept/decline paths - no leak observed.

group/[id].tsx row layout fix (rowMain/rowPills flex containers with numberOfLines=1) is a clean, minimal fix; rowPills has maxWidth:150 with flexWrap which could still wrap pills to 2 lines on very narrow devices with 3+ pills, but did not reproduce with current 2-pill max case.

success_rate.backend: N/A - not tested (frontend only per request)

seed_data_creation: 1) Generated a new multi-use invite-link token (YeXjjqix13e6gnZEywz0wmyzMMBkvzQM) on ana.demo's 'Grupo 1' via API. 2) Registered and fully onboarded a brand-new account (testinvite_88177@sentinelfamily.app, name 'Juandos Fernández Martínez') through the invite flow - now a real active member of 'Grupo 1' (intentional, per test instructions to add more test invitees). 3) Registered TEST_returning_user_1@sentinelfamily.app via API (never joined any group) to test the returning-incomplete-onboarding regression case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED (all via single continuous Playwright script per flow to preserve in-memory auth session - separate tool calls cause full page reloads that lose the in-memory access token, this is a TEST-METHODOLOGY constraint, not an app bug): (1) BUG FIX 1 PASS - brand new registration via /invite/<token> -> 'Crear cuenta para aceptar' goes terms->data->transparency->security->account(register)->consent->profile, and after saving profile lands DIRECTLY on /invite/<token> (confirmed via page.url before AND after accept), never visiting /onboarding/group; tapped 'Aceptar y unirme' successfully landed on /map with correct name 'Juandos Fernández Martínez' in top bar and success toast. (2) BUG FIX 2 PASS - registration (email/password) now always routes to /onboarding/consent right after account creation (confirmed screen title 'Decide qué compartes' with permission switches), before reaching /onboarding/profile. Google OAuth path not testable in this environment (no test Google account) but code in account.tsx google() has identical step-check logic as submit(), same fix applies. (3) BUG FIX 3 PASS - group/[id] member row for 'Juandos Fernández Martínez' renders on a single line with ellipsis ('Juandos Fernández M...'), no vertical single-character wrapping, pills ('Activo' + location pill) stacked cleanly to the right on a separate row area. (4) BUG FIX 4 PASS - both the group detail row pill and MemberSheet detail sheet for the active member now show 'Ubicación: permiso pendiente' (not ambiguous standalone 'Permiso pendiente'); status pill separately shows 'Activo'/'Miembro activo', unambiguous. (5) Regression PASS - ana.demo@sentinelfamily.app (completed onboarding) logs in and goes straight to /map, no consent/profile detour. (6) Regression PASS - registered a fresh account via API (onboarding.step='profile' by default), then logged in via UI ('Ya tengo cuenta' -> login mode) - correctly routed to /onboarding/consent -> /onboarding/profile -> (no pending invite) -> /onboarding/group with 'Tus grupos' screen, no crash, no loop. (7) Regression spot-check PASS - /onboarding/group screen (orbital creation UI) rendered correctly with 'Crea tu primer grupo' input after the returning-user flow completed profile, confirming no breakage; did not re-run the full rename/delete/role-picker deep-dive since iteration_9 already covered it thoroughly and no related files changed in this iteration.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found among the requested fix items. All 4 targeted bug fixes and all 3 regression checks verified working correctly end-to-end. Only a pre-existing minor cosmetic copy issue noted (untranslated 'open' invitation status in MemberSheet) - unrelated to this iteration's changes, reported as a low-priority action item.
